name: What should I do if I smell gas near my fireplace?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I smell gas near my fireplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you smell gas near your fireplace, immediately take the following steps: first, evacuate everyone from the building and move to a safe distance. Do not use light switches, phones, or any electrical devices, as this could ignite the gas. Once outside, call 911 or your gas utility company from a safe location. Then, contact Alpha-Plumbing Services. We will dispatch a qualified technician to assess and repair the leak safely. Do not re-enter your home until authorities confirm it is safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evacuate immediately, do not use electronics, and call 911 or your gas company. Then contact Alpha-Plumbing Services from a safe location.
